Use delimiter-masked AppendUnconstrainedStep for ordinary reasoning. After an explicit final-answer cue, scratch-to-final transition, or real budget pressure, use AppendUnconstrainedStep until helpers.EndsWithLeftDelimiter(generated) is true. Inside the span, use AppendConstrainedStep until helpers.EndsWithRightDelimiter(generated) is true. Do not use plain AppendConstrainedStep in natural delimiter mode; it cannot emit the closing delimiter. Do not break on `not helpers.CanConstrain` before checking helpers.IsComplete, because complete suffixes are exactly when `>>` may be emitted. Do not open immediately after a generic first word like To or The. Multiple verified spans are allowed, but for GSM prefer one delayed final expression unless earlier spans are named scratch assignments that the final span reuses. 3.
